gpt.text:
I can’t execute those commands here, but I can help you run them safely and interpret the results. Given the handoff state (no PASS candidates; none inconclusive), the “Next Commands” block is the right sequence.

## What to do next (in order)

### 1) Run AUB module autopilot + pick best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
**Expected outcome:** it runs module-level candidates registered in `module_registry.yaml`, evaluates them, and (with `--select-best`) updates the “current champion” module set if a candidate clearly wins.

**After it finishes, capture:**
- which candidate (if any) was selected as best
- the updated tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min
- any failures/timeouts

### 2) Run system-level autopilot
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
**Expected outcome:** it runs end-to-end/system candidate configurations from `system_candidates.yaml`. This can surface regressions not visible in isolated module tests.

**After it finishes, capture:**
- best system candidate (if any)
- delta vs champion on tuning and lockbox
- any “inconclusive” decisions and why (variance, too few runs, etc.)

### 3) Generate “next fix” recommendations
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Expected outcome:** a markdown report suggesting what to try next (e.g., modules with biggest gap, flaky tests, candidates to add, thresholds to adjust).

## If something looks off
- If **tuning improves but lockbox drops**, don’t promote; consider adjusting candidate constraints or increasing regularization/guardrails.
- If you get **inconclusive** results, re-run with more seeds/trials (whatever your harness supports) before selecting best.
- If **no candidates beat champion**, `next_fix.md` should guide where to invest next (often a specific module bottleneck or evaluation instability).

## Send me the outputs
Paste the tail of the logs (or the summary tables) from steps 1 and 2 plus the generated `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`, and I’ll recommend whether to promote anything and what to try next.
